outcome: agreement of Robson classification using different data sources
cohort: The study included all 15,413 deliveries, with 2,924 Caesarean sections, performed in 13 maternity units within a French perinatal network in 2014.
finding: The overall Caesarean section rate was 19% in 2014, with Robson groups 1, 2, and 5 being the most significant contributors, and there was excellent agreement between the simplified Robson classification derived from medical records and medico-administrative data.
mod_finding: The study found an overall Caesarean section rate of 19% in 2014, with Robson groups 1, 2, and 5 being the largest contributors to this rate.
